decisions.reason: The system is an incremental extension of established spraying technology with unresolved niche demand, so the option remains worth keeping at low carrying cost.
Its dedicated page and close fit with the firm's core sealing and bonding equipment signal active development and unresolved upside, so it is a low-cost option to retain.

Although the multi-model line ties up more resources and the firm has many alternative options, its demand is still uncertain and it builds on existing transfer technology, so the option is kept but under close review.
Fire protection monitoring is a specialized add-on with a dedicated page, and its regulatory demand is still uncertain, so the firm keeps the option at modest cost.
